description: Erection of a replacement two storey side extension with single storey front and side projections and installation of one first floor rear window and one rear roof light to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  A26 (Rev P3); A28 (Rev P3) Received:  24 November 2023;  A01 (Rev P1); A02 (Rev P1); A03 (Rev P1); A04 (Rev P1); A05 (Rev P1); A06 (Rev P1); A25 (Rev P1); A27 (Rev P1); A28 (Rev P1); A29 (Rev P1); A30 (Rev P1) Received:  06 September 2023.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the part two, part single storey side extension hereby approved.
